about.title: About OrderBook
about.description: OrderBook is a simple tool for creating grocery shopping lists and sharing them with local shopkeepers.
about.step1: Customer creates a grocery list with items, quantities, and units.
about.step2: Share the list with the shopkeeper via WhatsApp or QR code.
about.step3: Shopkeeper enters prices for each item.
about.step4: Shopkeeper sends an itemized invoice back via WhatsApp.
about.privacyText: OrderBook runs entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server. Your grocery lists and phone numbers are stored only on your device.

menu.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all items?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.point1: No data is collected or sent to any server.
privacy.point2: All data stays in your browser's local storage.
privacy.point3: Phone numbers are stored locally only for your convenience.
privacy.point4: Order data is shared only through the URL you generate.
privacy.point5: No cookies, no tracking, no analytics.
